question: Is the intended crawl-remote deployment compatible and ready for the fail-closed cloud-v2 publisher to become the default publication path?
rationale: The source and tests establish the client-side design, but only the service owner can confirm coordinated deployment readiness and accept the operator-impacting fail-closed rollout.

options.title: Require rollout proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until the current head succeeds against the intended remote deployment with redacted fresh-publish, retry, activation, cutover, and pinned-readback evidence.

options.title: Stage without automatic cutover
options.body: Allow a staged rollout only after confirming operators will use `--cutover=false` until remote compatibility and readback are verified.

options.title: Accept coordinated deployment risk
options.body: Merge with an explicit owner commitment that compatible CrawlKit and crawl-remote revisions will be deployed before operators use cloud-v2 publishing.

recommendation.title: Require rollout proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until the current head succeeds against the intended remote deployment with redacted fresh-publish, retry, activation, cutover, and pinned-readback evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The git history identifies this person as the original and current owner of the Gitcrawl cloud publication path.
